name: CuHalide Atlas
applicationCategory: Scientific database and evidence-grounded retrieval system
description: Prepublication review implementation for an evidence-grounded, structure-resolved Cu(I) chloride, bromide and iodide knowledge portal. Current Curated rev.9 is reviewed through 2026-08-19 and closes the current structure/member identity and terminal evidence boundaries; archived scientific snapshot 3.0.2 remains immutable. The active runtime includes Structured Photophysics 1.4.0, Organic Components 1.2.0 and Smart RAG 9.20.0. Direct-link access is query-and-view, search-engine indexing is disabled, and no permanent DOI, blanket license or formal public-release date is asserted until owner approval.
